summary: Master NEC Contracts Management Training with practical tools for programme control, compensation events, payment assessment, and closeout. Enquire now.
lede: NEC contract management covers the administration of contract communications, programme changes, compensation events and payments. For contract administrators, commercial managers, project controls engineers and project managers, the course develops practical skills in reviewing Accepted Programmes, tracking notice timelines, assessing payments and maintaining evidence through controlled records and closeout documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already touch project contracts and need stronger control over NEC administration, commercial records, and time-sensitive procedures. It is especially relevant when your role sits between delivery, cost, programme, and governance, where a missed notice or weak record can create avoidable exposure.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop for document review, spreadsheet exercises, and template completion. Familiarity with construction project terminology, contract notices, and basic commercial reporting will help you move quickly through the exercises. If available, bring a sample NEC contract excerpt, a project programme, or a payment or compensation event record for practical application.
